messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion completed: rdinfer/model-x @ prod -> artifact tag: v2026-03-15-768, image: rdinfer/model-x:sha256:ab12cd34
Alex: seeing weird NLP output spikes, users report tokenization errors in responses. rolling errors up to 5% on /v1/generate. Canary was green 30m ago. :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): paging in case this is rollout-related. I am on call, looking now.
Alex: logs show a sudden jump in unknown-token sequences and malformed json outputs from chat endpoint. sample: 
```
User: summarize the doc
Model: [UNK] [UNK]...
```
Rachel: can you paste the deploy diff? maybe tokenizer/vocab file changed in the artifact.
Alex: deploy-bot posted the promotion metadata: 
```
artifact: rdinfer/model-x@sha256:ab12cd34
manifest: model-config.yaml (sha: e3f9...)
vocab: vocab_v2.bin
```
Oliver: checking storage, looks like the promoted artifact contains vocab_v2.bin but the runtime mapping expects vocab_v1 mapping table (the labels/schema mismatch). probable cause: CI promoted wrong artifact tag during canary merge.
Sam (oncall): impact? customers?
Nisha: support reports elevated errors for 3 enterprise customers on EU region, some failing end-to-end tests. Ticket numbers: #CS-3346, #CS-3349. Potentially degraded NLU features for one customer.
Rachel: triage plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop routing traffic to the new model 2) roll back production routing to previous artifact 3) investigate promotion gating. Recommend kill-switch flag now.
Sam (oncall): flipping flag -> `POST /admin/flags/model-routing?model=model-x&route=previous`
Sam (oncall): executing flip now.
LogBot: feature-flag-change: model-routing:model-x set -> previous by Sam (oncall) at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z
Alex: traffic to v2026-03-15-768 dropped to 0. Canary had been 10% of traffic. Good.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01 (severity: sev2) — summary: model artifact vocab mismatch after promotion. Pager sent to eng-sre, infra, oncall.
Rachel: rolling back route to last-known-good artifact (sha: 9f8e7d6c). Rollback command: 
```
redwood deploy rollback --model model-x --to-sha 9f8e7d6c --env prod
```
Rachel: running rollback now.
Oliver: infra: starting quick validation of model-host processes post-rollback, checking KV cache invalidation for tokenizer mappings.
Alex: quick smoke: sample prompts look normal again. tokenization fixed in sample logs.
Nisha: notifying affected customers that we've mitigated and are investigating root cause. Draft message: "We've detected a bad model promotion impacting tokenization for some requests; traffic reverted to previous stable model and we are investigating. We'll follow up with RCA."
Sam (oncall): handing off to Rachel for deep-dive, I'm on for 15 more minutes then Alice will take the next shift.
Rachel: noted, I'll lead the RCA. Initial hypothesis: CI artifact tagging allowed a manifest-lite build with updated vocab file but without bumping runtime mapping metadata.
Oliver: saving repro steps and collecting the two artifacts (ab12cd34 and 9f8e7d6c). Will check CI promotion logs and artifact registry ACLs.
Alex: quick ask — are we sure the canary checks didn't run tokenization tests? If not, add explicit tokenizer smoke to canary suite.
Rachel: agreed — adding tokenizer-level checks to canary pipeline as action item.
incident-bot: Updating incident with current status: mitigated (traffic reverted), assessing customer impact, RCA owner assigned: Rachel.
Nisha: flagged for postmortem and communications. Will sync with legal if customers request deeper review.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. leaving the thread to Rachel -> handoff: next-oncall Alice. :thumbsup:
Rachel: logging next steps to incident tracker: 1) root cause analysis, 2) CI gating fix, 3) canary test expansion, 4) backfill tests, 5) customer follow-up. ETA for RCA draft: EOD.
Oliver: adding two logs to the incident: `/var/logs/deploy/promote-1798234567.log` and registry access audit entry id: audit-20260315-77.
Alex: good catch everyone. follow-ups later in #eng-runtime.
Nisha: closing loop once RCA posted.
LogBot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 status -> mitigated at 2026-03-15T14:22:40Z
